propositions: compact.py exceeds 800 LOC and bundles three unrelated responsibilities (transaction, snapshot reconstruction, CLI) with high local complexity metrics (24 CCN and 21 CCN functions)
splitting compact.py into three modules (facade + txn engine + rebuild engine) with acyclic dependency graph prevents circular imports when both engines need shared snapshot primitives
re-exporting moved symbols from compact.py preserves consumer import paths in fsck_repair.py, fsck_restore.py, and test files without requiring edits outside the module
counter co-location (moving _REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count together to compact_rebuild.py) is necessary so module-global mutation in rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log reads the correct value
monkeypatch test seams in test_compact_negative.py must be repointed from compact module object to compact_txn module object to apply to relocated functions
complexity-baseline.json entries for all three compact.py functions must shrink or be removed; no increases allowed by ratchet
